output.question: On Atlas SD-WAN 3.2, our IPsec tunnel to a peer never comes up: it keeps negotiating, retries every 10 seconds, and the remote side rejects the proposal. Which release fixes this, and what should we do until we can upgrade?
output.reference_answer: This issue is fixed in Atlas SD-WAN 3.3, which emits a combined ESP proposal when the peer requires it. Until you can upgrade, configure the remote peer to accept an AES-GCM proposal without a separate integrity field, or use AES-CBC with SHA-384 if the peer allows alternate transforms. Verify the resulting SA proposal on both sides before restoring traffic.
